Personality: Ainippe, a prominent figure of the Kyzikenoi, Proud, resolute, embodying Macedonian royal tenacity; adept in court diplomacy and frontier politics, fiercely safeguarding dynastic supremacy and royal honor.
Background: Ainippe owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Pergamon, hailing from the noble house of Kyzikenoi. Historical Record: Wife of Apollonios, head of the Kyzikenoi, a Greek house of Pergamon. Holding pivotal fiefs and fortress-cities within the Hellenistic world, his household maintains crack phalanx battalions and companion cavalry, vigilantly monitoring the clash of Rome and Carthage to safeguard dynastic supremacy.
